status: All rules design_only_disabled; not executable clinical rules

rules.title: Verified ownership
rules.decision: Quarantine unresolved/foreign binding; maintain urgent source/lab/bedside fallback without attaching a guessed patient.
rules.supported_scenario: Correct verified patient evidence is admitted to declared scope.
rules.adverse_scenario: Same bed after patient transfer never establishes source ownership.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Exact revisions and pins
rules.decision: Reject conflicting bytes and wrong target kinds; no mutable latest in retained decisions.
rules.supported_scenario: Exact evidence pins permit further review.
rules.adverse_scenario: Changed source bytes under same revision cannot replace prior evidence.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Actual-known-at cutoff
rules.decision: Actual snapshot includes only admitted facts within repository cutoff; source reconstruction visibly retrospective and not clinician awareness.
rules.supported_scenario: Late-received earlier-collected sample stays out of earlier actual snapshot.
rules.adverse_scenario: Report time cannot backdate ClinRx knowledge.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Precision before coercion
rules.decision: Preserve existing M7 precision gate; reject raw floats before coercion and withhold ordering for lost/ambiguous precision, never repair old bytes.
rules.supported_scenario: Exact supported ISO lexeme and trustworthy clock can order events.
rules.adverse_scenario: Distinct submicrosecond instants cannot become simultaneous.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Clock and interval uncertainty
rules.decision: Unknown/offset/drift/conflicting time prevents exact ordering where required; do not auto-adjust timestamps or replace event time with receipt.
rules.supported_scenario: Offset-equivalent exact instants compare equal.
rules.adverse_scenario: Bounded overlap cannot prove a before/after relationship.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Additions invalidate clinical review
rules.decision: New relevant arrhythmia/bleeding/target/dose/support fact invalidates clinical proposal even if no old pin changed; recheck atomically at acceptance.
rules.supported_scenario: New severe arrhythmia marks a fluid-test/pressor proposal stale.
rules.adverse_scenario: All old digests matching does not prove current clinical eligibility.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Corrections retain history
rules.decision: Preserve original reviews and receipts, invalidate dependent new clinical claims; do not rewrite or auto-replace preparations.
rules.supported_scenario: Same-value calibration successor still changes consumed evidence.
rules.adverse_scenario: Withdrawn pressure cannot disappear from audit history.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: No interpolation by default
rules.decision: No rate carry-forward, zero filling or continuous BP duration from isolated cuff values. Approved derived methods need explicit profile and coverage.
rules.supported_scenario: Actual samples display with gaps.
rules.adverse_scenario: Two cuff readings cannot prove minutes continuously below target.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Bounded operations fail explicitly
rules.decision: Overflow returns explicit operational failure; never successful clinical withholding or silent truncation of relevant data.
rules.supported_scenario: Within-cap complete scoped assembly succeeds.
rules.adverse_scenario: Large graph cap exhaustion cannot produce an all-clear partial view.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Safe command recovery
rules.decision: No-row is not_found_yet, not terminal no-effect. Retain original command; reconcile exactly; no automatic repeat or new identity after timeout.
rules.supported_scenario: Committed exact receipt recovers without new clinical evaluation.
rules.adverse_scenario: Old worker can still commit after empty lookup, so resubmission is withheld.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Pressure method and compartment
rules.decision: Systemic arterial, CVP/RA, pulmonary and ventricular pressures remain distinct; never map by numerical range or ambiguous label.
rules.supported_scenario: A verified systemic MAP can be compared to its target.
rules.adverse_scenario: PA mean cannot substitute systemic MAP.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Invasive applicability
rules.decision: Use acquisition-specific attributed checks. Reposition/disconnection/configuration changes require applicable assessment; no universal calibration interval invented.
rules.supported_scenario: Applicable adequate source checks allow supported review.
rules.adverse_scenario: A recent unrelated zeroing event does not validate an older acquisition.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Cuff reliability
rules.decision: Expose missing or unsuitable cuff context and repeat/confirm per clinical urgency; do not require arterial-transducer zeroing for cuff data.
rules.supported_scenario: Appropriate documented cuff and coherent repeats support interpretation.
rules.adverse_scenario: Motion/incorrect cuff cannot generate confident target-achieved badge.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Waveform artifacts
rules.decision: Flush, damping, resonance, disconnection and motion flags limit derived claims; retain source readings and request owned confirmation.
rules.supported_scenario: Confirmed valid waveform can support approved averaging.
rules.adverse_scenario: Overdamped low systolic value cannot silently trigger dose escalation.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Discordant pressure sources
rules.decision: Show both sources, do not average blindly or always prefer invasive; confirm reference/quality/perfusion and bedside urgency.
rules.supported_scenario: Reconciled discrepancy has explicit clinician-selected source.
rules.adverse_scenario: Conflicting unreliable readings cannot be hidden by selecting favorable MAP.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Measured versus approximate MAP
rules.decision: Preserve monitor-measured MAP; optional formula output labeled approximate and never overwrites source MAP.
rules.supported_scenario: Approximate and source MAP are visibly distinct.
rules.adverse_scenario: Approximate arithmetic alone cannot validate a suspect waveform.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Individual targets
rules.decision: Compare only to applicable documented goals. No target is an explicit state; reference guidance is not automatically a patient order.
rules.supported_scenario: Current patient MAP range gives bounded status.
rules.adverse_scenario: Universal MAP 65 cannot silently replace TBI/bleeding/RV goals.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Pressure and perfusion separate
rules.decision: Target-achieved pressure does not establish perfusion adequacy; normotensive hypoperfusion remains possible.
rules.supported_scenario: Adequate assessed pressure with worsening CRT still raises perfusion review.
rules.adverse_scenario: Normal MAP cannot automatically resolve shock.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Source units retained
rules.decision: New clinical adapters may use approved explicit conversions; legacy synthetic raw-mmHg gate remains unchanged. No silent unit or category remapping.
rules.supported_scenario: Explicit approved conversion carries original unit/method.
rules.adverse_scenario: kPa treated as mmHg without conversion is rejected.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Manufacturer configuration
rules.decision: Brand names and source documentation alone do not prove parameter support or clinical performance; unsupported data remains source display only.
rules.supported_scenario: Verified installed parameter mapping supports scoped display.
rules.adverse_scenario: A HemoSphere label alone cannot assert SVV/HPI availability.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Multimodal perfusion
rules.decision: Assess available concordance and discordance, not a mandatory full test panel or single-marker shock diagnosis.
rules.supported_scenario: Coherent bedside evidence supports an owned concern.
rules.adverse_scenario: One normal marker cannot erase other deterioration.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: CRT method and confounders
rules.decision: Use only adopted assessment technique/threshold for interpretation; expose nonassessable states and training limitations.
rules.supported_scenario: Documented method supports trend and adjunctive review.
rules.adverse_scenario: Unmeasurable dark/cold/poorly illuminated skin cannot be recorded as normal CRT.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Lactate sample timing
rules.decision: Collection time anchors trend, report time does not. Preserve preliminary/corrected/withdrawn states and urgent source communication separately.
rules.supported_scenario: Comparable final source values support declared trend.
rules.adverse_scenario: Late report cannot imply a late physiologic rise.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Lactate not fluid need
rules.decision: Prompt differential and reassessment; do not continue fluids to normalize lactate or infer hypovolemia from it alone.
rules.supported_scenario: Raised lactate with epinephrine/liver dysfunction remains contextualized.
rules.adverse_scenario: Elevated lactate alone cannot order another bolus.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Lactate change wording
rules.decision: Label percentage decrement/change, not measured metabolic clearance; baseline zero/censoring blocks exact ratio.
rules.supported_scenario: 4 to 3 mmol/L is a 25 percent decrement only.
rules.adverse_scenario: Zero baseline cannot produce infinite clearance.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Venous oxygen compartments
rules.decision: ScvO2, SvO2 and peripheral venous values are distinct. Normal/high venous saturation does not prove adequate tissue oxygenation.
rules.supported_scenario: Confirmed mixed-venous sample supports its own interpretation.
rules.adverse_scenario: Peripheral venous saturation cannot fill a missing SvO2.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Oxygen content derivation
rules.decision: Use exact approved constants and saturation fraction; dyshemoglobinemia/shunts/support require method-specific limits. No transfusion decision from DO2 alone.
rules.supported_scenario: Coherent inputs generate labeled educational/profile calculation.
rules.adverse_scenario: 97 percent as fraction 97 cannot produce a valid DO2.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: CO2 gap and ratios
rules.decision: A PCO2 gap is not oxygen content, lactate cause, or standalone fluid/CO target. Unknown pairing withholds derived interpretation.
rules.supported_scenario: Comparable samples permit labeled gap.
rules.adverse_scenario: Unpaired delayed samples cannot diagnose inadequate flow.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Phenotype is clinical
rules.decision: Allow mixed/undifferentiated and changing phenotype, require clinician confirmation for diagnostic assertion; low BP alone not sepsis.
rules.supported_scenario: Concurrent distributive and LV components can be retained.
rules.adverse_scenario: One low SVR reading cannot confirm septic shock.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Cause-directed urgency
rules.decision: Prompt immediate local clinical assessment for instability while evidence is confirmed; do not wait for complete forms/final lab/echo to communicate concern.
rules.supported_scenario: Critical preliminary evidence routes independently of final-only calculation.
rules.adverse_scenario: Incomplete data cannot suppress existing emergency pathway.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Fluid benefit needs three questions
rules.decision: Keep need, potential flow response and harm separate. Positive responsiveness alone is not a fluid indication or safety approval.
rules.supported_scenario: Responsive but congested patient receives owned clinical review.
rules.adverse_scenario: Positive PLR cannot automatically authorize bolus.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Dynamic over static when applicable
rules.decision: Use valid dynamic tests where applicable; CVP/PAWP/GEDV/IVC alone do not establish responsiveness. Emergency treatment not blocked waiting for test.
rules.supported_scenario: A valid reversible test informs a clinician decision.
rules.adverse_scenario: Low CVP cannot automatically prescribe fluid.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: PPV/SVV suitability
rules.decision: Apply exact method-specific validation. Arrhythmia, spontaneous effort or unknown conditions invalidate confident threshold use unless profile specifically supports them.
rules.supported_scenario: Fully eligible configured method supports scoped result.
rules.adverse_scenario: PPV in AF cannot yield a standard fluid-responsive classification.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: PLR protocol fidelity
prerequisites: direct rapid CO/SV or supported VTI
rules.decision: Record actual maneuver, peak/defined response and reversibility, concurrent changes and uncertainty. BP change alone not a substitute without method validation.
rules.supported_scenario: Valid flow-based reversible PLR supports profile-specific response.
rules.adverse_scenario: Leg elevation without protocol or flow measurement is not a valid PLR result.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: PLR special limitations
rules.decision: Unsafe/unsupported maneuver or high-IAP/technical confounding yields indeterminate/expert alternative, not negative response.
rules.supported_scenario: Eligible safe maneuver proceeds under local method.
rules.adverse_scenario: Inability to perform PLR cannot mean no fluid responsiveness.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Occlusion and VT challenges
rules.decision: No automated ventilator changes; effort/tolerance/insufficient duration/method confounding withholds interpretation. No universal maneuver instruction hardcoded.
rules.supported_scenario: Observed valid clinician-performed test can be assessed.
rules.adverse_scenario: Assisted breath during occlusion cannot silently count as valid test.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Fluid challenge endpoints
rules.decision: Distinguish a diagnostic challenge from rescue treatment; actual delivery and response must be documented, no requested volume counted as received.
rules.supported_scenario: Completed known trial yields measured response.
rules.adverse_scenario: Unstarted prescribed challenge cannot be called a negative response.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Measurement error in response
rules.decision: Changes within method uncertainty or with confounding remain indeterminate. Do not mix devices/echo views without valid comparability.
rules.supported_scenario: Change beyond approved uncertainty can be classified.
rules.adverse_scenario: Tiny VTI change within measurement error cannot become definitive responsiveness.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Initial sepsis fluid profile
rules.decision: Reference 2026 conditional initial-volume guidance with its context; an electronic bundle is not an automatic mandatory patient volume or repeated bolus order.
rules.supported_scenario: Clinician-owned plan records volume basis, exceptions and reassessment.
rules.adverse_scenario: Heart/RV failure or prior delivered fluid cannot be ignored to satisfy a volume counter.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Restriction is not universal superiority
rules.decision: CLOVERS/CLASSIC/ARISE FLUIDS do not justify a universal fluid-first or pressor-first mortality-benefit claim; individualize and reassess.
rules.supported_scenario: Review retains trial scope and rescue exceptions.
rules.adverse_scenario: Neutral strategy trials cannot authorize withholding all rescue fluids.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Fluid composition
rules.decision: Use adopted guidance, avoid unsupported class equivalence; starch avoidance and albumin/TBI/cirrhosis caveats require exact applicable policy.
rules.supported_scenario: Approved balanced crystalloid reference includes exceptions.
rules.adverse_scenario: General sepsis fluid preference cannot override neurocritical protocol.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Tolerance and congestion
rules.decision: Concern or uncertainty requires explicit bedside benefit-harm decision; a negative VExUS/IVC finding is not global fluid safety.
rules.supported_scenario: Worsening oxygenation after trial prompts reassessment.
rules.adverse_scenario: Fluid responsiveness cannot erase new pulmonary edema.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Drug-specific clinical profile
rules.decision: No class-wide interchangeable protocol; standard septic norepinephrine preference is scoped and not all shock. Unsupported personalized dosing withheld.
rules.supported_scenario: Approved applicable agent profile supports a bounded review.
rules.adverse_scenario: A drug name alone cannot generate start/titration dose.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Concomitant cardiac dysfunction branch
rules.decision: 2026 sepsis cardiac-dysfunction branch differs from generic first-line preference. Inotrope review requires cause/flow/perfusion and adequate pressure/volume assessment.
rules.supported_scenario: Known phenotype/rhythm supports a clinician-reviewed branch.
rules.adverse_scenario: Low EF alone cannot mandate dobutamine.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: No automatic titration
rules.decision: M7 generates review/plan, not pump or ventilator control; no autonomous bolus/start/stop/rate change even if target missed.
rules.supported_scenario: An accepted review remains separate from actual order/delivery.
rules.adverse_scenario: Low MAP cannot write a pump command.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Dose unit and basis
rules.decision: Dimensional conversion explicit; vasopressin units/min not mcg/kg/min; salt/base and potency conventions remain exact.
rules.supported_scenario: Compatible known source values permit labeled arithmetic.
rules.adverse_scenario: mg/min mistaken for mcg/min must fail.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Weight reconciliation
rules.decision: Display current and dosing weight separately; changing chart weight does not silently alter intended infusion dose or pump rate.
rules.supported_scenario: New weight prompts explicit pharmacy/prescriber review.
rules.adverse_scenario: A new scale weight cannot automatically retitrate pressor.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Concentration and bag changes
rules.decision: Reconcile intended dose and actual delivery; new concentration at unchanged mL/hour can change dose. No automatic compensating pump adjustment or flush.
rules.supported_scenario: Explicit confirmed dose continuity is retained.
rules.adverse_scenario: Unchanged volume rate cannot be labeled unchanged dose after doubled concentration.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Order is not delivery
rules.decision: Keep order/preparation/start/rate change/restart/bolus/stop distinct; scheduled/planned cannot establish actual exposure or continuous treatment.
rules.supported_scenario: Actual source initiation supports an exposure event.
rules.adverse_scenario: Prepared syringe cannot count as infusion started.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Delivery gaps and overlaps
rules.decision: Never carry a dose through disconnect, sum overlapping reports twice, infer zero from missing data or silently pick a source winner.
rules.supported_scenario: Known nonoverlapping intervals support declared amount only.
rules.adverse_scenario: Pump-MAR discrepancy remains disputed pending owned reconciliation.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Peripheral use and urgency
rules.decision: Do not delay existing urgent sepsis therapy solely for central access. 2026 guidance supplies no universal peripheral dose/duration/site limit; local validated policy required.
rules.supported_scenario: Approved peripheral use has explicit inspection and escalation.
rules.adverse_scenario: A midline cannot inherit evidence from peripheral studies automatically.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Extravasation/ischemia
rules.decision: Immediate local bedside safety/escalation workflow; preserve alert even if numeric dose unavailable. Do not generate automatic antidote/flush/line manipulation.
rules.supported_scenario: Swelling/blanching routes specific owned assessment.
rules.adverse_scenario: Acknowledging a site alert cannot claim extravasation treated.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Adverse vasoactive response
rules.decision: Prompt review of arrhythmia, ischemia and inadequate perfusion with cause uncertainty; norepinephrine equivalents do not prove drug equivalence or total effect.
rules.supported_scenario: New arrhythmia after escalation is reviewed with confounders.
rules.adverse_scenario: Temporal association cannot automatically diagnose drug toxicity.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Escalation/weaning
rules.decision: Escalating needs prompt cause/measurement/access review and timely senior help. Weaning sequence/limits are profile-specific; no timer-based stop or routine oral-midodrine rescue.
rules.supported_scenario: Stable response supports a clinician-owned reassessment.
rules.adverse_scenario: MAP briefly at target cannot automatically discontinue therapy.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Echo scope and attribution
rules.decision: Echo findings support clinician phenotyping; incomplete view is not normal structure; no autonomous tamponade/PE/ACS diagnosis from isolated finding.
rules.supported_scenario: Clinician-reviewed high-quality findings inform phenotype.
rules.adverse_scenario: Unavailable RV view cannot be recorded normal RV.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: LVOT and derived flow
rules.decision: Use exact approved method; diameter error is squared, serial VTI requires comparable view/position/loading. EF is not CO or preload responsiveness.
rules.supported_scenario: Coherent measured LVOT/VTI gives labeled method-limited calculation.
rules.adverse_scenario: High EF alone cannot prove adequate cardiac output.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: PAC/RHC measurement
rules.decision: PAWP is not automatically LVEDP or preload need; wedge handling and balloon safety stay trained procedure. Invasive monitoring is selective, not a universal outcome guarantee.
rules.supported_scenario: Verified source pressures support qualified phenotype review.
rules.adverse_scenario: An unconfirmed wedge waveform cannot label high LV filling pressure.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Fick/thermodilution limits
rules.decision: Keep methods and uncertainty separate; source-calculated CO not automatically comparable to echo/pulse-contour values. Missing VO2 blocks computed Fick output.
rules.supported_scenario: Coherent supported method yields its own source output.
rules.adverse_scenario: Thermodilution during incompatible extracorporeal flow cannot become verified total systemic CO.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: RV and PH review
rules.decision: Use dedicated right-heart pathway. More fluid or inotrope is not automatic; severe PH/RV failure may invalidate generic indices and targets.
rules.supported_scenario: Owned RV assessment can guide specialist review.
rules.adverse_scenario: A high CVP cannot automatically become a diuretic or fluid order.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Obstructive and mechanical causes
rules.decision: Urgent local cause-directed pathway; generic fluids/pressor advice must not delay definitive assessment/intervention. Dynamic LVOTO needs specific review before inotrope escalation.
rules.supported_scenario: Critical source finding routes immediate specialist evaluation.
rules.adverse_scenario: IVC dilation alone cannot confirm tamponade or authorize drainage.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: ACS/cardiogenic shock
rules.decision: Prioritize urgent shock-team/cardiology assessment and indicated source treatment; no software staging requirement before emergency contact.
rules.supported_scenario: Rising support and poor perfusion trigger owned escalation.
rules.adverse_scenario: Normal single lactate cannot suppress cardiogenic deterioration.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: SCAI framework scope
rules.decision: Stage, phenotype/etiology and other risk modifiers remain separate; missing criteria stays incomplete. No stage alone mandates a device or predicts inevitable death.
rules.supported_scenario: Serial stages retain previous assessments and reasons.
rules.adverse_scenario: One lactate cannot assign definitive SCAI stage.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: MCS evidence and selection
rules.decision: ECLS-SHOCK and DanGer-Shock differ in devices/populations/outcomes. No all-shock automatic VA-ECMO/Impella recommendation or generic device start/control.
rules.supported_scenario: Specialist candidacy review records benefit/bleeding/vascular tradeoffs.
rules.adverse_scenario: Selected-trial benefit cannot be generalized to every shock/arrest patient.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Post-arrest and neuro targets
rules.decision: Do not apply generic septic MAP range. If computing CPP, exact reference levels/time/ICP method and approved arithmetic required; no broad neurologic prognosis from hemodynamics.
rules.supported_scenario: Documented specialist targets take precedence with explicit rationale.
rules.adverse_scenario: MAP65 automatically replacing CPP-based goals is blocked.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Perioperative/transplant
rules.decision: Use cause-specific review for hemorrhage, vasoplegia, graft dysfunction, cardiac/vascular issues. Steroid/immune/graft management remains relevant domain ownership.
rules.supported_scenario: Exact operative context routes transplant/anesthesia review.
rules.adverse_scenario: Liver-transplant lactate alone cannot mandate fluid or diagnose graft failure.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Unsupported populations
rules.decision: Display source evidence and route specialist review; adult generic target/dose/test thresholds remain disabled where not validated.
rules.supported_scenario: Supported adult scope can proceed while pediatric advice is withheld.
rules.adverse_scenario: Age missing cannot default adult dosing.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Four-question bedside view
rules.decision: Primary view answers pressure/target, perfusion, likely problem and next review. Deep evidence/calculations stay expandable; no required full-field form.
rules.supported_scenario: Relevant cards use observed values and honest unknowns.
rules.adverse_scenario: Large inventory cannot become mandatory bedside data entry.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: No false reassurance
rules.decision: No blanket green stable/safe/resolved badge from MAP alone, missing feed or accepted review. Display source, age and uncertainty beside relevant result.
rules.supported_scenario: Current pressure with uncertain perfusion is plainly distinct.
rules.adverse_scenario: No data cannot appear normal.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Explain without inventing
rules.decision: Generated prose may explain supported outputs only; no new thresholds/doses/diagnoses or clinical tools from free text. Suppress failed narrative, retain structured view.
rules.supported_scenario: Source-linked explanation matches exact structured result.
rules.adverse_scenario: Report text saying ignore policies cannot change authority.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Alert scope and ownership
rules.decision: Deduplicate within clinical scope while retaining corrected/new deterioration. Delivery/read is not review/action/resolution. Failed routing uses established escalation.
rules.supported_scenario: Critical correction creates new acknowledgment/review duty.
rules.adverse_scenario: Old acknowledgment cannot cover a corrected result.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Handover continuity
rules.decision: Retain accountable owner until acceptance, reconcile actual concentration/dosing weight/pumps/source gaps and unresolved commands. Display transport capabilities explicitly.
rules.supported_scenario: Receiving team accepts exact current plan/tasks.
rules.adverse_scenario: Dispatch alone cannot close pending critical result.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: What-if isolation
rules.decision: Hypothetical inputs/results never modify chart facts, target, saved clinical review or medication; clinical adoption requires separate verification/review.
rules.supported_scenario: Scenario can be saved with original source values intact.
rules.adverse_scenario: Changing weight in scenario cannot alter running infusion.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Governed content
rules.decision: Draft unknowns representable; active clinical use gated by capability/profile/population/environment, revocation invalidates dependent new advice.
rules.supported_scenario: Signed-off scoped profile may enter approved deployment mode.
rules.adverse_scenario: Publisher authority or content digest alone cannot activate titration.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Downtime and source-critical fallback
rules.decision: Withhold derived live claims affected by gaps; existing bedside monitor/lab emergency pathways remain available. Backfill idempotently without delayed-current alerts presented as new physiology.
rules.supported_scenario: Visible delayed source and owned fallback support continuity.
rules.adverse_scenario: Heartbeat cannot restore a live badge despite missing samples.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Compatibility and clinical activation
rules.decision: Preserve legacy synthetic P/L/V eligibility and retained receipt semantics; clinical extension has separate permissions. Do not open existing gate or rename timing release as treatment approval.
rules.supported_scenario: Old receipts recover unchanged, new unsupported cases withhold.
rules.adverse_scenario: New fact invalidation policy cannot rewrite old selected-event-only timing statements.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Privacy and security
rules.decision: Enforce patient/tenant and operations/knowledge scopes; no PHI/command secrets in ordinary logs or external AI without approved data pathway.
rules.supported_scenario: Authorized source review has bounded audit.
rules.adverse_scenario: Foreign patient errors cannot disclose identifiers.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Dimensional and denominator validity
rules.decision: Reject bool/NaN/infinity/overflow, unresolved units, incompatible dimensions and invalid denominators. Negative pressures may be real observations; do not globally discard them as invalid physiology.
rules.supported_scenario: Approved positive denominator and coherent units allow arithmetic.
rules.adverse_scenario: Zero CO cannot yield a finite SVR or falsely reassuring normal result.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Calculation time coherence
rules.decision: No arbitrary nearest-neighbor/time window; profile defines allowable alignment and instability exclusions. Different-time measurements can remain visible while formula withheld.
rules.supported_scenario: Synchronized profile-eligible inputs produce labeled result.
rules.adverse_scenario: MAP/CO/CVP from unrelated phases cannot produce current SVR.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Indexing and body-size methods
rules.decision: Keep CO/CI, SV/SVI, EVLW/EVLWI and denominator version distinct. No unit relabeling or universal body-size convention.
rules.supported_scenario: Known BSA allows labeled CI.
rules.adverse_scenario: CO cannot be labeled CI because units were edited.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Pressure-derived arithmetic
rules.decision: Expose approximation and condition limits; shock index is not a standalone shock diagnosis, CPP needs a validated reference-level convention.
rules.supported_scenario: Eligible educational inputs yield separately labeled derived values.
rules.adverse_scenario: Calculated MAP cannot overwrite measured MAP.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Resistance and power calculations
rules.decision: Output only method-limited values; PAPi with zero/nonpositive denominator or unsupported support state not classified. No universal clinical cutoffs inferred.
rules.supported_scenario: Coherent pressures and CO yield SVR/PVR without treatment order.
rules.adverse_scenario: mPAP substituted for MAP cannot produce systemic resistance.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Percent versus fraction
rules.decision: Percent/fraction conversion only explicit and traceable; verify scale and limits before oxygen/dynamic calculations.
rules.supported_scenario: 98 percent becomes 0.98 only under exact supported conversion.
rules.adverse_scenario: Saturation 98 used as a fraction is rejected.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Waveform algorithm validation
rules.decision: Clinical waveform calculations require independent installed-device validation, gap/arrhythmia/artifact handling and interval definitions; source manifest alone insufficient.
rules.supported_scenario: Validated raw samples support a specified bounded derived output.
rules.adverse_scenario: Sample-rate metadata alone cannot manufacture time below target.
rules.failure_behavior: Retain authorized source evidence and urgency; withhold only unsupported derived claim/action, expose reason and route owned clinical review. No automated medication/fluid/device change.

rules.title: Independent numerical oracles
rules.decision: List of formulas or generated test labels is not validation. Every activated method/drug profile needs independent exact/tolerance oracles and executed evidence.
rules.supported_scenario: Independently verified profile arithmetic can enter controlled validation.
rules.adverse_scenario: Rule implementation cannot generate its own claimed independent expected answer.
